result.title: Stealing Exact Training Data from Other Clients during Federated Learning
result.summary: Malicious adversaries can employ gradient inversion attacks to reverse-engineer private data using the model updates of a round in Federated Learning. While there have been developments in gradient inversion for text, exact text recovery by a malicious client has so far remained infeasible, as FedAvg entangles the gradient contributions of many clients and obscures the signal of any individual sentence. We introduce a novel attack pipeline that unwinds this entanglement progressively through an iterative loop, in which the gradient contributions of sentences recovered exactly in one round are subtracted from the aggregate, exposing the remaining sentences for recovery in the next iteration. We show, for the first time, exact sentence recovery, with 100% precision, and on aggregates containing up to $4\times$ more tokens than the model's hidden dimension, we recover up to 80.2% of client sentences exactly, a regime where existing attacks recover none exactly.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出一种联邦学习下的梯度反演攻击流程：在迭代循环中把本轮已精确恢复的句子的梯度贡献从聚合更新中减去，逐步解开多客户端梯度的纠缠，从而暴露出其余句子，实现在聚合 token 数远超隐藏维度时仍能精确还原大量客户端句子。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属隐私攻击领域，与 VLM 推理无直接关联，但其「先精确恢复一部分、再从聚合信号中显式扣除该部分贡献」的迭代解耦策略，可能为 LVR 中混合 latent 状态或视觉证据的贡献分解与逐步剥离提供概念线索，具体类比关系仍需核查。
